description: The file defines a React functional component 'Column' representing a Kanban board column, including state management for inline editing, theme-specific styles, and modal dialogs for delete confirmation. It also manages interactions like editing the column title, deleting the column, and rendering child CardList component.

methods.name: validateNewTitle(str)
methods.description: Validates the new title for the column, ensuring it is not empty and differs from the current title.

methods.name: triggerTitleEdit
methods.description: Initializes editing mode for the column title input.

methods.name: saveEditTitle
methods.description: Saves the new title if validation passes; handles API update and shows toast messages.

methods.name: handleTitleInputKey
methods.description: Handles key events for the title input, triggering save or cancel.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets the modal state to show delete confirmation.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes the column by calling deleteColumn and showing a feedback toast.

methods.name: Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })
